name: esperanza-backend
description: Cloudflare CMS stack for Esperanza Homes (D1 + R2 + Workers/Queues/Cron + Next.js admin). Source of truth for the public site.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply esperanza --local --config packages/db/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply esperanza --remote --config packages/db/wrangler.toml
